comment: The walkthrough for revision 1. Units are chosen by path and optional text, resolved to unit IDs when the demo is built, so it survives changes in unit numbering.
title: Split helpers and add reconciliation

steps.title: Ledger engine
steps.why: The batch limit and the new reconciliation are the behavior changes; everything else follows from them.

steps.title: Module split
steps.why: Helpers move to their own modules; the moves should be byte-for-byte, the formatter change is deliberate.

steps.title: Front end and tools
steps.why: Display gains a currency, the client calls the new reconciliation and a view shows its mismatches; the stats script reports the maximum and a notifier posts mismatches.

steps.title: Native and mobile clients
steps.why: The C interface, its C++ and JNI wrappers and the schema must agree on how long an account name may be.

steps.title: Packaging
steps.why: A new dependency, executable scripts and checksummed downloads, tests in the image and CI, the new docs and logo.
